description.en: Removes one or more party members with a full "member left" presentation: optionally fades out/stops the current BGM, waits, then for each member plays a system SE jingle, shows the departure message, and removes the member (via RemovePartyCmnd when _not_pt_lock is true, RemoveParty otherwise), before restoring the BGM. The general engine behind RemoveParty_Message/RemovePartyNum_Message.
Number of members to remove (length of the following array arguments).
Array of param IDs, one per member to remove.
Array of status-reset flags, one per member.
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence; a negative value skips fading/stopping the BGM entirely.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
System SE ID to play for each removed member.
Unused by this implementation (kept for signature compatibility).
Message ID shown via CreateSpeech for each removed member.
Optional; when true, removes members via RemovePartyCmnd without locking their slot instead of via RemoveParty (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove several party members with a jingle and departure message (as RemovePartyNum_Message does)
RemoveParty_MessageEx(_rmv_num, _aParamID, _aStReset, 30, 45, 21, 0, "sysmes-remove_party", _not_pt_lock);
